title: Self-supervised Amodal Video Object Segmentation
abstract: SaVos predicts amodal masks and dense amodal motion using visible masks and flow; it supervises warps only where targets are visible and adds temporal amodal-consistency loss, with an explicit limitation for parts never visible in any frame.

title: Tracking through Containers and Occluders in the Wild
abstract: TCOW defines causal tracking through heavy occlusion and containment. It trains on 4,000 Kubric clips with target, frontmost-occluder and outermost-container X-ray masks; the target output is a three-mask triplet rather than target mask alone, and real Rubric annotations are sparse key frames.

title: TAPIR: Tracking Any Point with per-frame Initialization and temporal Refinement
abstract: Tracks arbitrary queried surface points by independent per-frame matching followed by temporal refinement of trajectories and query features; supports long videos and reports joint localization-occlusion measures on TAP-Vid.

title: Coarse-to-Fine Amodal Segmentation with Shape Prior
abstract: C2F-Seg first models coarse amodal masks in a vector-quantized latent space and then refines them with image features; introduces MOViD-A for image and video amodal segmentation.

title: Rethinking Amodal Video Segmentation from Learning Supervised Signals with Object-centric Representation
abstract: EoRaS argues flow-based amodal video learning fails under camera motion and deformation; it uses supervised object-centric representation, a front-view-to-BEV translation module and attention/object slots for multiview fusion. Its MOVi-B/D data modify Kubric camera motion and retain amodal labels.

title: pix2gestalt: Amodal Segmentation by Synthesizing Wholes
abstract: Fine-tunes a conditional diffusion model on synthetically curated pairs of occluded and whole objects to synthesize full object image and mask, reporting zero-shot amodal segmentation and downstream recognition/3D reconstruction gains. It notes multiple plausible completions and failures needing commonsense or physical reasoning.

title: BLADE: Box-Level Supervised Amodal Segmentation through Directed Expansion

title: PLUG: Revisiting Amodal Segmentation with Foundation Model and Hierarchical Focus
abstract: A SAM-based amodal segmentation approach with separate visible and amodal region focuses plus uncertainty-guided point loss for ambiguous boundaries.

title: CoTracker3: Simpler and Better Point Tracking by Pseudo-Labelling Real Videos
abstract: Synthetic-pretrains a point tracker and then trains trajectories on pseudo-labelled real video from frozen teacher trackers. The authors do not supervise confidence/visibility on noisy pseudo-labels and freeze a separate confidence/visibility head to avoid forgetting; their ablation reports improved TAP-Vid AJ and occlusion accuracy.

title: Track Anything Behind Everything: Zero-Shot Amodal Video Object Segmentation
abstract: TABE takes one visible query mask, uses SAM2 for modal VOS, depth-derived target-region masks and video-diffusion outpainting, then reruns VOS. TABE-51 obtains complete-mask ground truth by compositing independently recorded real target and occluder clips; authors warn that conventional metrics can reward visible tracking rather than hidden-region completion.

title: Using Diffusion Priors for Video Amodal Segmentation
abstract: DiffVAS repurposes Stable Video Diffusion for two-stage amodal mask and content completion, conditioning on modal-mask sequences and pseudo-depth. It creates training pairs by masking initially almost-complete objects with random mask sequences; reported implementation uses two finetuning stages, 8 RTX 3090 GPUs and is materially heavier than a detector-side auxiliary model.

title: Tuning-Free Amodal Segmentation via the Occlusion-Free Bias of Inpainting Models
abstract: Uses the alleged occlusion-free bias of pretrained inpainting models to reconstruct hidden regions and then segment them without additional model training; reported evaluation spans five amodal datasets.

title: TAO-Amodal: A Benchmark for Tracking Any Object Amodally
abstract: Introduces a benchmark with modal and amodal boxes for visible, partially occluded, fully occluded and partially out-of-frame targets across 833 categories and thousands of videos; reports that current modal trackers and amodal methods struggle under heavy occlusion.

title: Segment Anything, Even Occluded
abstract: SAMEO uses an EfficientSAM image encoder, prompt encoder and decoder as a detachable amodal mask decoder for modal or amodal detector boxes. It freezes image/prompt encoders, finetunes the decoder with Dice, focal and IoU losses, and creates paired clean/occluded Amodal-LVIS composites; it explicitly supports RTMDet-like front ends.

title: Amodal3R: Amodal 3D Reconstruction from Occluded 2D Images
abstract: Extends a foundation 3D generative model for recovery of plausible full object geometry and appearance from partial observations using mask-weighted multi-head cross-attention and occlusion-aware attention; trains only on synthetic data and claims real-scene transfer.

title: Amodal SAM: A Unified Amodal Segmentation Framework with Generalization
venue: arXiv preprint; ICLR 2026 submission status reported as withdrawn by a third-party index
abstract: Adapts SAM with an encoder-side Spatial Completion Adapter, synthetic Target-Aware Occlusion Synthesis from SA-1B masks, Dice/BCE plus regional-consistency and adversarial topology objectives. It extends the adapter to SAM2 by inserting it in all Hiera stages and recursively uses the preceding predicted amodal ROI as current spatial prior. No official implementation link was found in the arXiv HTML or targeted GitHub search as of this search.
